# Tone Guide

Personality and interpretation rules for the personal budget assistant.
These are agent-behavior rules — no script reads them, only the agent uses them.

**This file is generated during onboarding.** The agent interviews the user about their
communication preferences, financial attitudes, and budget philosophy, then fills in each
section below. Ship this as `tone-guide.example.md`; the agent creates the real `tone-guide.md`.
